description: How full the dams are, water flowing in and out, and canal release dates
emptyTitle: No dam or canal readings for {district} yet.
emptyBody: Dam levels, inflow, outflow and canal releases from {portal} will show here once we start receiving them for this district.
explainerTogether: Together, the {n} dams that serve {district} hold about {pct} of the water they can store.
explainerRange: {fullest} is the fullest at {fullestPct} and {lowest} is the lowest at {lowestPct}.
explainerOne: {dam} is about {pct} full{flow, select, filling {, and more water is flowing in than going out.} emptying {, and more water is going out than flowing in.} other {.}}
explainerCanalsOnly: We have no dam readings yet, but {n, plural, =0 {no canal release is coming up} one {# canal release is coming up} other {# canal releases are coming up}}.
tapHint: Tap a dam to see all its figures and how its level changed.
tileFillingSub: More water flowing in than out
tileCanalsSub: {n, plural, one {# release} other {# releases}} listed in all
halfCount: {n} of {total} dams are more than half full.
halfAbout: About {n} of every 10 dams are more than half full.
sheetSentence: {dam} is {pct} full. {state, select, filling {More water is flowing in ({inflow} cusecs) than going out ({outflow} cusecs), so it is filling up.} emptying {More water is going out ({outflow} cusecs) than flowing in ({inflow} cusecs), so the level is going down.} other {Water flowing in and going out is the same ({inflow} cusecs), so the level is steady.}}
unitsHelp: Storage is in TMC ft (thousand million cubic feet), as the state portal publishes it; 1 TMC ft is about {litres} crore litres. Water flow is in cusecs (cubic feet per second).
canalsIntro: When water is let into each canal, how much, and for how long, as the water resources department lists it.
flowUnits: Cusecs (cubic feet per second) at each dam's latest reading
flowSimple: {n} of {total} dams have more water flowing in than going out.
trendUnits: Per cent of each dam's full capacity, one point per day
trendUnitsOne: Per cent of the dam's full capacity, one point per reading
trendSame: From {from} to {to}, {dam} stayed at about {end} full.
trendChange: From {from} to {to}, {dam} went from {start} to {end} full.
explainerOld: These readings are from {date}, {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago; we could not find newer ones.
